answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks via a staked vouching graph gated by max-flow cuts. Each candidate joins as a vertex receiving directed edges backed by slashable stake from a seed core. Verifiers check that min-cut flow scales with admitted nodes so subgraphs cannot harbor fake clusters; creating a brittle shale of self-endorsing accounts adds no cut capacity, forcing attackers to lock capital per identity. However, colluding vouchers can still sell underpriced bridge edges.
